name: IPTV Hub
description: Serve IPTV from M3U playlists (URL, server path or upload) with XMLTV guides, playlist categories and your own custom categories.

versions.changelog: Fix: Live TV channels are now actually tagged with their categories (1.2.0.0 matched no channels). Correction: 1.2.0.0 did not merge channels or rebuild Live TV channels; favourites and recordings were never affected.

Live TV channels are tagged with their categories (click a tag on a channel to list that category). Channels sharing a guide id (HD/SD variants) are no longer merged into one Live TV channel; Live TV channels are rebuilt once after updating.
Playlist groups automatically become categories with their channels already in them. Categories can be renamed, reordered, merged and hidden, or hide all their channels.
